name: Order Tip/Donation for WooCommerce
author: jyotsnasingh520

sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin dashboard.
  3. Click Upload Plugin and choose the downloaded zip file.
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  5. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Tips/Donations to configure options.
sections.faq:
Can I customize the label for tips/donations?

Yes, you can set a custom label for both tips and donations in the plugin settings.

Does it support multiple languages?

Yes, you can create different tip/donation options for different languages.

Don’t want to show tip option when user is only buying virtual product like gift card

Yes, you can hide tip option when user is buying all virtual products

Does this Tip/Donation plugin work with WooCommerce Block based Checkout and Cart page?

Yes, this plugin works with WooCommerce Block based Checkout and Cart page
sections.description:
Add an option for customers to leave a tip or make a donation during checkout on your WooCommerce store. Enhance user experience and increase revenue.

🚀 Enhance Your WooCommerce Store with Our Ultimate Tip & Donation Plugin

Accept Tips & Donations Seamlessly in WooCommerce

Our WooCommerce Tips & Donations Plugin is the perfect solution for store owners who want to encourage customer generosity by allowing them to add a tip or donation to their order at checkout. Whether you run a restaurant, nonprofit organization, freelancer service, or any WooCommerce store that benefits from customer contributions, this plugin makes the process seamless and user-friendly.

Why Use This Plugin?

In today’s eCommerce landscape, customers appreciate the option to support businesses and causes they love. This plugin integrates smoothly into your WooCommerce store, ensuring that tipping or donating is simple, flexible, and fully customizable.

✅ Key Features & Benefits

1️⃣ Multiple Tip & Donation Options

✔️ Allow customers to add a custom tip or choose from predefined tip percentages.
✔️ Offer fixed-amount donations to support a cause, charity, or business operations.
✔️ Enable tipping as a percentage of the cart total or a fixed amount.

2️⃣ Seamless Checkout Integration

✔️ Display the tipping/donation option on the cart page, checkout page, or both.
✔️ Provide a smooth and intuitive experience for customers without disrupting the order flow.
✔️ Works flawlessly with WooCommerce payment gateways.

3️⃣ Customizable UI & Display Settings

✔️ Modify the tip section text, labels, and colors to match your brand.
✔️ Enable or disable tipping for specific user roles.

4️⃣ Guest Checkout Support

✔️ Store tips and donations even if the customer is not logged in.
✔️ Collect customer email and transaction details for tracking.

5️⃣ Compatibility & Performance

✔️ Fully compatible with the latest WooCommerce and WordPress versions.
✔️ Lightweight and optimized for speed & performance.
✔️ Works with other WooCommerce plugins.

🎯 Use Cases for This Plugin

✔️ Restaurants & Cafés – Accept tips online for food delivery and takeaway orders.
✔️ Nonprofits & Charities – Collect donations to support a cause.
✔️ Freelancers & Service Providers – Let customers add tips for excellent service.
✔️ eCommerce Stores – Allow customers to support your business with a small contribution.
✔️ Event Organizers – Accept donations for virtual or in-person events.

🔥 Why Choose Our Plugin Over Others?

✔️ User-Friendly Setup – No coding required. Just install, configure, and start collecting tips!
✔️ Highly Customizable – Adjust settings, labels, and display options to fit your needs.
✔️ Mobile Responsive – Works seamlessly on all devices, including desktops, tablets, and smartphones.
✔️ Regular Updates & Support – We continuously improve the plugin based on user feedback.

💎 Upgrade to the Pro Version for More Features!

The Pro version unlocks additional features, including:
🚀 Advanced analytics – Get insights into customer tipping behavior.
🚀 Collect tax on the tip and donation amount
